name: synonym-comparison
title: Near-synonym comparison
description: Compare near-synonyms or variants (e.g. big/large, task/assignment): frequency and dispersion of each word, their collocates side by side (shared vs. exclusive) and a KWIC sample of each.

words.description: Two or more single words to compare.

interpretation: usage compares frequency, range and DP of each word. comparison lists every collocate with the compared words it attaches to: N_NODES > 1 = shared collocate (overlap in meaning); N_NODES = 1 = exclusive (see NODES) - these show the differences. Exclusive collocates are listed after shared ones; page with result_page or filter with result_filter(where='N_NODES == 1', sort_by='BEST_LOGDICE'). Words that produced no collocates appear in collocates.errors. Use the KWIC samples (kwic.items) to characterise typical contexts, register and evaluative prosody of each word.
